description: This file defines the AppDatabase class for an Android application using Room persistence library. It manages database creation, singleton instance retrieval, and provides access to the ProfileEntity data access object (DAO).

classes.name: AppDatabase
classes.description: Abstract class representing the Room database for the application, including DAO access and singleton pattern implementation.

methods.name: profileDao
methods.description: Abstract method to access the ProfileDao, which handles profile-related database operations.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the singleton instance of AppDatabase, initializing it if it doesn't exist.
